# Deprecated Workflows (Azure)

These workflows were originally added to deploy the Whalezchain Enterprise Orchestrator to Microsoft Azure (AKS + ACR).

As of the Sovereign Baseline (2026-02-09), Azure execution surfaces are retired.
- Default runtime: self-hosted Docker / containerized deployment
- Cloud surfaces (AWS/GCP) are optional and must be explicitly approved and wired

Do not move these back into `.github/workflows/` without governance approval and an explicit change-control entry.
